              "    'Tiga fungsi kecil, persis tiga langkah di slide 5:\\n',\n",
              "    '- `jarak_ke_pusat`: jarak Euclidean (Pythagoras — rumus yang sama dengan K-NN di P4) dari setiap titik ke setiap pusat;\\n',\n",
              "    '- `bagi`: tiap titik ikut pusat terdekat;\\n',\n",
              "    '- `geser`: pusat pindah ke rata-rata anggotanya.\\n',\n",
              "    '\\n',\n",
              "    '`inertia` (J) = jumlah kuadrat jarak tiap titik ke pusat kerumunannya — \"total meleset\" versi tanpa kunci jawaban. Bishop (2006) §9.1 membuktikan J tidak pernah naik setelah langkah bagi maupun geser → pasti berhenti.']},\n",
              "  {'cell_type': 'code',\n",
              "   'execution_count': 5,\n",
              "   'id': '19d35219',\n",
              "   'metadata': {'execution': {'iopub.execute_input': '2026-10-01T03:13:05.004664Z',\n",
              "     'iopub.status.busy': '2026-10-01T03:13:05.004237Z',\n",
              "     'iopub.status.idle': '2026-10-01T03:13:05.014949Z',\n",
              "     'shell.execute_reply': '2026-10-01T03:13:05.013445Z'}},\n",
              "   'outputs': [],\n",
              "   'source': ['def jarak_ke_pusat(Z, pusat):\\n',\n",
              "    '    \"\"\"Mengembalikan matriks (n_titik x k): jarak Euclidean titik i ke pusat j.\\n',\n",
              "    '    Z[:, None, :] - pusat[None, :, :] memakai broadcasting numpy supaya tidak perlu loop.\"\"\"\\n',\n",
              "    '    return np.sqrt(((Z[:, None, :] - pusat[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2))\\n',\n",
              "    '\\n',\n",
              "    'def bagi(Z, pusat):\\n',\n",
              "    '    \"\"\"Langkah \\'bagi\\': label tiap titik = indeks pusat terdekat.\"\"\"\\n',\n",
              "    '    return jarak_ke_pusat(Z, pusat).argmin(axis=1)\\n',\n",
              "    '\\n',\n",
              "    'def geser(Z, label, k):\\n',\n",
              "    '    \"\"\"Langkah \\'geser\\': pusat baru = rata-rata anggota tiap kerumunan.\"\"\"\\n',\n",

        "    \"    \\\"\\\"\\\"Mengembalikan matriks (n_titik x k): jarak Euclidean titik i ke pusat j.\\n\",\n",
        "    \"    Z[:, None, :] - pusat[None, :, :] memakai broadcasting numpy supaya tidak perlu loop.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\",\n",
        "    \"    return np.sqrt(((Z[:, None, :] - pusat[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2))\\n\",\n",

        "    \"def silhouette_manual(Z, label):\\n\",\n",
        "    \"    n = len(Z); D = np.sqrt(((Z[:, None, :] - Z[None, :, :]) ** 2).sum(axis=2))   # jarak antar semua titik\\n\",\n",
        "    \"    s = np.zeros(n)\\n\",\n",
        "    \"    for i in range(n):\\n\",\n",
        "    \"        sendiri = (label == label[i]); sendiri[i] = False             # anggota kerumunan sendiri, kecuali diri sendiri\\n\",\n",
        "    \"        a = D[i, sendiri].mean()\\n\",\n",
        "    \"        b = min(D[i, label == j].mean() for j in set(label) if j != label[i])   # kerumunan lain terdekat\\n\",\n",
        "    \"        s[i] = (b - a) / max(a, b)\\n\",\n",
        "    \"    return s\\n\",\n",
        "    \"\\n\",\n",
        "    \"s = silhouette_manual(Z, label)\\n\",\n",
        "    \"print(pd.DataFrame({\\\"s\\\": s.round(2)}, index=w8.wisatawan).T)\\n\",\n",
        "    \"print(\\\"Skor silhouette (rata-rata):\\\", s.mean().round(3))\\n\",\n",
        "    \"\\n\",\n",
        "    \"from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score          # cek dengan scikit-learn: harus sama\\n\",\n",
        "    \"print(\\\"scikit-learn               :\\\", round(silhouette_score(Z, label), 3))\"\n",
        "   ]\n",
        "  },\n",

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score\n",
        "from sklearn.decomposition import PCA\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import os, urllib.request\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# PERSIAPAN — fungsi pembantu\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "DATA_DIR = \"data\"\n",
        "os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "def muat(nama_file, url_cadangan=None, pembuat=None):\n",
        "    path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, nama_file)\n",
        "    if os.path.exists(path):\n",
        "        print(f\"[muat] membaca {path}\")\n",
        "        return pd.read_csv(path)\n",
        "    if url_cadangan is not None:\n",
        "        print(f\"[muat] {path} tidak ada -> mengunduh dari {url_cadangan}\")\n",
        "        urllib.request.urlretrieve(url_cadangan, path)\n",
        "        return pd.read_csv(path)\n",
        "    if pembuat is not None:\n",
        "        print(f\"[muat] {path} tidak ada -> membuat ulang data sintetis\")\n",
        "        df = pembuat(); df.to_csv(path, index=False)\n",
        "        return df\n",
        "    raise FileNotFoundError(path)\n",
        "\n",
        "def buat_wisatawan_1200():\n",
        "    rng = np.random.default_rng(6); n = 1200\n",
        "    tipe = rng.choice(4, n, p=[0.30, 0.30, 0.22, 0.18])\n",
        "    mu = {0: [8, 250, 90, 2, 10, 1.3], 1: [4, 900, 350, 4, 45, 3.8],\n",
        "          2: [2, 1200, 200, 0.5, 7, 1.1], 3: [3, 2800, 700, 5, 60, 2.0]}\n",
        "    sd = {0: [2.5, 80, 30, 1, 6, 0.5], 1: [1.2, 250, 100, 1.5, 15, 1.0],\n",
        "          2: [0.8, 300, 70, 0.7, 4, 0.3], 3: [1, 600, 200, 1.5, 20, 0.2]}\n",
        "    X = np.zeros((n, 6))\n",
        "    for s in range(4):\n",
        "        m = tipe == s\n",
        "        X[m] = rng.normal(mu[s], sd[s], size=(m.sum(), 6))\n",
        "    df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=[\"lama_tinggal\", \"belanja_akomodasi_per_malam\", \"belanja_kuliner_per_hari\",\n",
        "                                  \"jumlah_aktivitas\", \"lead_time_hari\", \"jumlah_orang\"])\n",
        "    df[\"lama_tinggal\"] = df.lama_tinggal.clip(1, 20).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df[\"belanja_akomodasi_per_malam\"] = df.belanja_akomodasi_per_malam.clip(100, 6000).round(-1)\n",
        "    df[\"belanja_kuliner_per_hari\"] = df.belanja_kuliner_per_hari.clip(30, 2000).round(-1)\n",
        "    df[\"jumlah_aktivitas\"] = df.jumlah_aktivitas.clip(0, 12).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df[\"lead_time_hari\"] = df.lead_time_hari.clip(0, 180).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df[\"jumlah_orang\"] = df.jumlah_orang.clip(1, 8).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df.insert(0, \"id_wisatawan\", [f\"T{i:04d}\" for i in range(1, n + 1)])\n",
        "    return df\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# PERSIAPAN — muat data\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "wisatawan = muat(\"wisatawan_1200_sintetis.csv\", pembuat=buat_wisatawan_1200)\n",
        "FITUR = [\"lama_tinggal\", \"belanja_akomodasi_per_malam\", \"belanja_kuliner_per_hari\", \"jumlah_aktivitas\", \"lead_time_hari\", \"jumlah_orang\"]\n",
        "Z = StandardScaler().fit_transform(wisatawan[FITUR])\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Bagian A · Berapa kerumunan?\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "hasil = []\n",
        "for k in range(2, 9):\n",
        "    km_z = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(Z)\n",
        "    km_m = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(wisatawan[FITUR])\n",
        "    hasil.append({\"k\": k, \"inertia_Z\": round(km_z.inertia_),\n",
        "                  \"silhouette_Z\": round(silhouette_score(Z, km_z.labels_), 3),\n",
        "                  \"silhouette_mentah\": round(silhouette_score(wisatawan[FITUR], km_m.labels_), 3)})\n",
        "hasil = pd.DataFrame(hasil).set_index(\"k\")\n",
        "print(hasil)\n",
        "\n",
        "k_pilihan = 4\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Bagian B · Beri nama & promo\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "km = KMeans(n_clusters=k_pilihan, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(Z)\n",
        "wisatawan[\"cluster\"] = km.labels_\n",
        "profil = wisatawan.groupby(\"cluster\")[FITUR].mean().round(0)\n",
        "profil[\"n\"] = wisatawan.cluster.value_counts().sort_index()\n",
        "print(\"\\nProfil Segmen (Satuan Asli):\")\n",
        "print(profil)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Bagian C · Peta & pemeriksaan\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "peta = PCA(n_components=2).fit(Z)\n",
        "P = peta.transform(Z)\n",
        "print(\"\\nporsi sebaran:\", peta.explained_variance_ratio_.round(2))\n",
        "print(pd.DataFrame(peta.components_.T, index=FITUR, columns=[\"sumbu1\", \"sumbu2\"]).round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))\n",
        "plt.scatter(P[:, 0], P[:, 1], c=km.labels_, s=8, cmap=\"tab10\")\n",
        "pusat = peta.transform(km.cluster_centers_)\n",
        "plt.scatter(pusat[:, 0], pusat[:, 1], marker=\"X\", s=150, c=\"black\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"sumbu 1\"); plt.ylabel(\"sumbu 2\"); plt.title(\"Peta segmen\"); plt.show()"

        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.cluster import KMeans\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score\n",
        "from sklearn.decomposition import PCA\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import os, urllib.request\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# PERSIAPAN — fungsi pembantu pembuatan data\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "DATA_DIR = \"data\"\n",
        "os.makedirs(DATA_DIR, exist_ok=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "def muat(nama_file, url_cadangan=None, pembuat=None):\n",
        "    path = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, nama_file)\n",
        "    if os.path.exists(path):\n",
        "        print(f\"[muat] membaca {path}\")\n",
        "        return pd.read_csv(path)\n",
        "    if url_cadangan is not None:\n",
        "        print(f\"[muat] {path} tidak ada -> mengunduh dari {url_cadangan}\")\n",
        "        urllib.request.urlretrieve(url_cadangan, path)\n",
        "        return pd.read_csv(path)\n",
        "    if pembuat is not None:\n",
        "        print(f\"[muat] {path} tidak ada -> membuat ulang data sintetis\")\n",
        "        df = pembuat(); df.to_csv(path, index=False)\n",
        "        return df\n",
        "    raise FileNotFoundError(path)\n",
        "\n",
        "def buat_wisatawan_1200():\n",
        "    rng = np.random.default_rng(6); n = 1200\n",
        "    tipe = rng.choice(4, n, p=[0.30, 0.30, 0.22, 0.18])\n",
        "    mu = {0: [8, 250, 90, 2, 10, 1.3], 1: [4, 900, 350, 4, 45, 3.8],\n",
        "          2: [2, 1200, 200, 0.5, 7, 1.1], 3: [3, 2800, 700, 5, 60, 2.0]}\n",
        "    sd = {0: [2.5, 80, 30, 1, 6, 0.5], 1: [1.2, 250, 100, 1.5, 15, 1.0],\n",
        "          2: [0.8, 300, 70, 0.7, 4, 0.3], 3: [1, 600, 200, 1.5, 20, 0.2]}\n",
        "    X = np.zeros((n, 6))\n",
        "    for s in range(4):\n",
        "        m = tipe == s\n",
        "        X[m] = rng.normal(mu[s], sd[s], size=(m.sum(), 6))\n",
        "    df = pd.DataFrame(X, columns=[\"lama_tinggal\", \"belanja_akomodasi_per_malam\", \"belanja_kuliner_per_hari\",\n",
        "                                  \"jumlah_aktivitas\", \"lead_time_hari\", \"jumlah_orang\"])\n",
        "    df[\"lama_tinggal\"] = df.lama_tinggal.clip(1, 20).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df[\"belanja_akomodasi_per_malam\"] = df.belanja_akomodasi_per_malam.clip(100, 6000).round(-1)\n",
        "    df[\"belanja_kuliner_per_hari\"] = df.belanja_kuliner_per_hari.clip(30, 2000).round(-1)\n",
        "    df[\"jumlah_aktivitas\"] = df.jumlah_aktivitas.clip(0, 12).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df[\"lead_time_hari\"] = df.lead_time_hari.clip(0, 180).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df[\"jumlah_orang\"] = df.jumlah_orang.clip(1, 8).round().astype(int)\n",
        "    df.insert(0, \"id_wisatawan\", [f\"T{i:04d}\" for i in range(1, n + 1)])\n",
        "    return df\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# PERSIAPAN — muat data\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "wisatawan = muat(\"wisatawan_1200_sintetis.csv\", pembuat=buat_wisatawan_1200)\n",
        "FITUR = [\"lama_tinggal\", \"belanja_akomodasi_per_malam\", \"belanja_kuliner_per_hari\", \"jumlah_aktivitas\", \"lead_time_hari\", \"jumlah_orang\"]\n",
        "Z = StandardScaler().fit_transform(wisatawan[FITUR])\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Bagian A · Berapa kerumunan?\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "hasil = []\n",
        "for k in range(2, 9):\n",
        "    km_z = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(Z)\n",
        "    km_m = KMeans(n_clusters=k, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(wisatawan[FITUR])\n",
        "    hasil.append({\"k\": k, \"inertia_Z\": round(km_z.inertia_),\n",
        "                  \"silhouette_Z\": round(silhouette_score(Z, km_z.labels_), 3),\n",
        "                  \"silhouette_mentah\": round(silhouette_score(wisatawan[FITUR], km_m.labels_), 3)})\n",
        "hasil = pd.DataFrame(hasil).set_index(\"k\")\n",
        "print(hasil)\n",
        "\n",
        "k_pilihan = 4\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Bagian B · Beri nama & promo\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "km = KMeans(n_clusters=k_pilihan, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(Z)\n",
        "wisatawan[\"cluster\"] = km.labels_\n",
        "profil = wisatawan.groupby(\"cluster\")[FITUR].mean().round(0)\n",
        "profil[\"n\"] = wisatawan.cluster.value_counts().sort_index()\n",
        "print(\"\\nProfil Segmen (Satuan Asli):\")\n",
        "print(profil)\n",
        "\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "# Bagian C · Peta & pemeriksaan\n",
        "# ============================================================\n",
        "peta = PCA(n_components=2).fit(Z)\n",
        "P = peta.transform(Z)\n",
        "print(\"\\nporsi sebaran:\", peta.explained_variance_ratio_.round(2))\n",
        "print(pd.DataFrame(peta.components_.T, index=FITUR, columns=[\"sumbu1\", \"sumbu2\"]).round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6.5, 4.5))\n",
        "plt.scatter(P[:, 0], P[:, 1], c=km.labels_, s=8, cmap=\"tab10\")\n",
        "pusat = peta.transform(km.cluster_centers_)\n",
        "plt.scatter(pusat[:, 0], pusat[:, 1], marker=\"X\", s=150, c=\"black\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"sumbu 1\"); plt.ylabel(\"sumbu 2\"); plt.title(\"Peta segmen\"); plt.show()"
